design_amendment.reason: The 20-update pipeline pilot was intentionally noninferential and did not learn a policy distinct from the heuristic. An independent 500-update grid-9 calibration recovered the intended safe-center mechanism. The confirmatory seed count was increased from 8 to 16 so the minimum attainable two-sided exact sign-randomization p-value remains resolvable after Holm adjustment across 120 registered contrasts.

evidence_scope: Controlled one-decision extreme-case mechanism and computational sensitivity; not city evacuation efficacy

evaluation.multiplicity: Holm adjustment across all registered RL-baseline sensitivity contrasts

city_complexity.interpretation: The controlled utility uses physical grid-cell distance and fixed service range; graph size is used for measured preprocessing/state-aggregation timing

state_aggregation_benchmark.scope: Vectorized assignment of road-node-sampled pedestrian positions to regional cells; excludes routing, congestion, hazards, and movement

observational_simulator_timing.scope: Incomplete legacy model-version-8 training launch; elapsed episode intervals reconstructed from run_metadata and episode_summary file timestamps
observational_simulator_timing.claim_limit: Descriptive runtime evidence only; not a complete or current-version training result
